# Reproducing This Book {#sec-reproduce}

Every number in this book can be regenerated from the repository. This
appendix records how, and what the numbers were produced with.

## From a clean checkout

```bash
python -m venv ~/.venvs/star-book && source ~/.venvs/star-book/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
pip install --no-deps bloqade-circuit==0.15.3   # no pyqrack: see README
pip install -e .
python tools/install_kernel.py   # registers the `star-book` kernel
make fetch                       # QuEra's circuits, pinned + hash-checked
make check                       # every offline guard
make book                        # website + PDF into book/_book/
```

Expensive measurements are not re-run by a render. Each is produced once by
a `tools/measure_*.py` script that executes a registered protocol, and is
committed under `data/results/` with its date, seed and environment. A
chapter reads those files; `tools/check_results.py` refuses any that lack
their provenance, and `tools/check_protocols.py` refuses any older than the
protocol that describes them.

## The environment that produced the numbers

```{python}
#| echo: false
import json
import pathlib

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
root = next(p for p in (root, *root.parents) if (p / "starlab").is_dir())
capture = json.loads((root / "data/environment-capture.json").read_text())
print(f"{'python':<18}{capture['python']}  ({capture['captured']})")
for group, packages in capture["packages"].items():
    for name, version in packages.items():
        print(f"{name:<18}{version or 'not installed'}")
```
